name: Little Red Wagon Native Nursery
metaTitle: Little Red Wagon: Nursery in Beach Park
metaDescription: Little Red Wagon at 4113 Henderson Blvd sells native plants and opens a butterfly garden. Last admission is 4:00pm, and the shop does not ship.

publish.hoursNote: Schema hours are the plant and gift shop. Living exhibits and the butterfly garden open 30 minutes later and stop admission at 4:00pm. No shipping or delivery.

facts: Little Red Wagon Native Nursery, garden centre, Beach Park / MacDill, Tampa. Address 4113 Henderson Blvd, Tampa, FL 33629. Listing phone +1-813-755-9579. Website https://littleredwagonnativenursery.com/.

Plant and gift shop: Monday through Friday 11:00am to 5:00pm, Saturday 9:00am to 5:00pm, Sunday 11:00am to 5:00pm. Living exhibits and butterfly garden: weekdays and Sunday 11:30am to 5:00pm, Saturday 9:30am to 5:00pm. Last admission at 4:00pm.

Purchase single day tickets at the registers. The site says it does not offer shipping or delivery. Online orders are for pickup on a date you choose. A custom order form is in the plant shop menu. Example plant prices on the page include from $7.00 and from $18.00.

Departments named: plants, collections, bug zoo and garden, gift shop, books and stationery, children's corner, garden and outdoor, home, personal care and apparel, newsletter, foundation. Mission: nurture native landscapes. Purpose: promote beneficial native plants. Proceeds benefit the Tampa Bay Butterfly Foundation.
No weekly hours were stored in our database.

faq.q: Does Little Red Wagon ship plants?
faq.a: The site says it does not offer shipping or delivery. Online purchases are held for pickup at 4113 Henderson Blvd.

faq.q: When is last admission to the butterfly garden?
faq.a: The hours block says last admission is 4:00pm, while the plant and gift shop stays open until 5:00pm.
The site says proceeds benefit the Tampa Bay Butterfly Foundation's conservation, education, and research work.
